scope: Full-target least absolute degree-one lift of the beta boundary unit, its exact continuant and centered-Euclidean reduction, the generic-continuant barrier, and asymmetric transfer to proper Item265 de-overlapped targets

claims.label: PROVED
claims.evidence: report Section 2, recurrence induction and continuant matrix
claims.scope_limit: this is an exact all-n description, not an asymptotic estimate for the centered square residue

claims.label: PROVED_CENTERED_REMAINDER
claims.claim: With a=q_(n-1), b=q_n and kappa=floor((2a^2+b)/(2b)), r_n=a^2-kappa*b is the unique centered residue of q_(n+1)^2 modulo b and rho_n=|r_n|.
claims.scope_limit: the exact formula alone gives only 1<=rho_n< b/2

claims.label: PROVED_DEGREE_ONE_EQUIVALENCE
claims.claim: The minimum absolute coefficient of a monic linear annihilator of -q_(n+1)^2 modulo q_n is exactly rho_n, so its minimum logarithmic height is log rho_n.
claims.scope_limit: neither log rho_n=O(n) nor its negation is proved

claims.label: PROVED_EUCLIDEAN_DETERMINANT
claims.claim: Writing A=4n-2, b=Aa+c and h=a-Akappa gives r_n=a*h-c*kappa, A*r_n=b*h-a*c, the constrained arithmetic-progression minimum, and the two exact rational-approximation determinant formulas.
claims.scope_limit: ordinary rational separation yields only rho_n>=1

claims.label: PROVED_COPRIMALITY
claims.scope_limit: this lower bound has no useful beta-saddle height

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_METHOD_BARRIER
claims.claim: For every palindromic positive continued-fraction word, the numerator square is congruent to plus or minus 1 modulo the denominator; such words can have arbitrary length and large entries.
claims.evidence: report Section 5, symmetry and determinant of the continuant matrix
claims.scope_limit: the beta arithmetic-progression word is not palindromic, so a theorem exploiting its exact asymmetry is not excluded

claims.label: PROVED_PROPER_TARGET_REDUCTION
claims.claim: For every Q>1 dividing q_n, the signed least residue is the centered reduction of r_n modulo Q and rho_(n,Q)<=min(rho_n,(Q-1)/2).
claims.scope_limit: full-target upper bounds transfer to proper Q; full-target lower bounds do not

claims.label: PROVED_DEOVERLAP_AND_BASELINE_SPLIT
claims.claim: Proper Q may be any divisor of q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m), while the common coefficient/product factor gcd(Q,B_n) remains the separate Item282 baseline.

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: On the replay rows 2<=n<=160, 2*rho_n>=q_(n-1), with the smallest checked ratio at n=4 where q_3=71 and rho_4=36.
claims.evidence: canonical certificate bounded row and digest
claims.scope_limit: the half-bound is unproved globally and is not used for asymptotic inference

claims.label: OPEN_EXACT_MISSING_LEMMA
claims.claim: The precise remaining full-target problem is to prove log rho_n=O(n), or instead a lower bound with log rho_n/n tending to infinity, using the exact arithmetic-progression word.
claims.scope_limit: generic continuant size bounds cannot decide it

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The checker replays exact beta continuants, centered quotients, Euclidean determinants, proper-target reductions, and a palindromic counterfamily.
claims.scope_limit: no exceptional-prime search or asymptotic extrapolation is performed

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: No all-n full or large proper-target lift bound and no product-baseline theorem is proved; booking remains zero.
claims.scope_limit: Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi remain open
